part.text:
Implemented a TypeScript static site generator CLI with all requested features, tests, and project setup.

What’s included
- Frontmatter parsing: title, date, tags, draft via gray-matter
- Markdown rendering with syntax highlighting via markdown-it + highlight.js
- Handlebars templates:
  - Partials loaded from templates/partials
  - Layouts loaded from templates/layouts; default layout is layouts/layout.hbs
  - Per-page template via frontmatter.template (default: post)
- Tag index pages: out/tags/<tag>/index.html
- RSS feed generation via feed, using --base-url and --site-title
- Dev server with live reload:
  - Express static server
  - ws WebSocket server broadcasting reload on file changes
  - chokidar watcher on source and templates
  - Reload script injected into generated HTML during dev
- Asset copying: non-Markdown files from source copied to output
- CLI via commander:
  - build: ts-ssg build -s <src> -t <templates> -o <out> [--base-url] [--site-title] [--include-drafts] [--clean]
  - dev: ts-ssg dev -s <src> -t <templates> -o <out> [-p <port>] [same flags as build]
- Tests (vitest):
  - Frontmatter parsing and template rendering with layout and partials
  - Syntax highlighting present
  - Draft behavior with --include-drafts
  - Live reload script injection in dev
  - RSS file generation
  - Asset copying behavior
- Project setup:
  - package.json with scripts: build, test
  - tsconfig.json (ESM, strict)
  - ESM-compatible imports across the codebase
  - CLI binary entry (bin -> dist/index.js) with shebang

Key files
- src/index.ts: CLI entry and runCli for tests
- src/generator.ts: buildSite with markdown render, template/layout render, tag pages, RSS, static asset copy
- src/templates.ts: loads templates, partials, and layouts; provides renderTemplate/renderWithLayout
- src/markdown.ts: markdown-it + highlight.js configuration
- src/server.ts: dev server with Express + WebSocket + chokidar
- tests/ssg.test.ts: comprehensive tests

How to use
1. Install dependencies:
   - npm install
2. Run tests:
   - npm test
3. Build the CLI:
   - npm run build
4. Run build:
   - node dist/index.js build -s path/to/src -t path/to/templates -o path/to/out --base-url https://example.com --site-title "My Site"
5. Run dev server with live reload:
   - node dist/index.js dev -s path/to/src -t path/to/templates -o path/to/out -p 5173 --base-url http://localhost:5173

Template expectations
- At minimum, provide:
  - templates/post.hbs to render a page’s content via {{{content}}}
  - templates/layouts/layout.hbs containing {{{body}}}
- Optional:
  - templates/index.hbs to customize the homepage
  - templates/tag.hbs to customize tag pages
  - templates/partials/*.hbs for shared partials

Notes
- Draft posts are excluded unless --include-drafts is specified.
- Feed is written to out/feed.xml and uses --base-url to construct absolute links.
- Live reload is only injected in dev server builds.

Everything is implemented and verified by the passing test suite.
